source.sqlReaderQuery: SELECT (SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) FROM dbo.abonnes) AS abonnes,(SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) FROM dbo.stations) AS stations,(SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) FROM dbo.locations) AS locations,HAS_PERMS_BY_NAME('dbo.locations','OBJECT','UPDATE') AS can_update_locations,HAS_PERMS_BY_NAME('dbo.sp_commit_watermark','OBJECT','EXECUTE') AS can_commit,IS_MEMBER('db_owner') AS is_db_owner,(SELECT TYPE_NAME(user_type_id) FROM sys.parameters WHERE object_id=OBJECT_ID('dbo.sp_commit_watermark') AND name='@new_watermark') AS watermark_parameter_type,(SELECT scale FROM sys.parameters WHERE object_id=OBJECT_ID('dbo.sp_commit_watermark') AND name='@new_watermark') AS watermark_parameter_scale
